newsitem.title: THAILAND: GF names National Finance new Thai bank advisor.
newsitem.headline: GF names National Finance new Thai bank advisor.

text.p: Thailand's General Finance and Securities Plc (GF) on Thursday appointed National Finance and Securities Plc advisor and sponsor to an initial public offering of shares in GF's new banking project.
An application to issue 375 million shares at 10 baht each would be submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission in March, a General Finance spokesman told Reuters.
The new bank will be headquartered in Thailand's north eastern city of Khon Kaen. The firm said it planned to distribute 10 percent of the shares in the new bank to residents of Khon Kaen.
A further 40 percent would be issued to the general public. The remaining 50 percent would be allocated to members of GF's banking consortium. Total capital of the new bank would be 7.5 billion baht.
General Finance and Securities will act as registrar.
